articles.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has alleged that China carried out what he called the "largest compromise of election data in history," claiming Beijing obtained 220 million U.S. voter files beginning during the 2020 election cycle. The White House described the alleged breach as an unprecedented election security threat. However, the Chinese Embassy has denied the accusation, saying China has never interfered in U.S. presidential elections. Meanwhile, a 2021 unclassified U.S. intelligence assessment found no evidence that any foreign actor altered voter registrations, ballots, vote tabulation, or the official results of the 2020 election.
